title: UI to authenticated Alice HTTP API

requirements.initial: Requests have controlled peer, Origin, and session state.
requirements.action: Read or mutate an API route.
requirements.expected: Remote requests require valid sessions; untrusted mutation Origins are rejected.

evidence.scope: Hono middleware with synthetic request context.

evidence.assertion: Host: localhost spoof does not grant bypass
evidence.scope: Spoofed headers against a controlled peer.

requirements.gap: A shared request/response fixture used by UI, backend, and demo is not yet mapped.

requirements.initial: The UI selected execution may change during an API response.
requirements.action: Interrupt and refresh authoritative Session state.
requirements.expected: Identity is preserved; stale responses are dropped and failures remain visible.

evidence.assertion: drops late responses after selection changes and reports failures
evidence.scope: Mock fetch responses; does not call production routes.

requirements.gap: Matching hook/route/demo schema, error shape, and cancellation contract needs shared evidence.
